name: Phyrexian Swarmlord
oracle_text:
Infect (This creature deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters and to players in the form of poison counters.)
At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 green Phyrexian Insect creature token with infect for each poison counter your opponents have.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 green Phyrexian Insect creature token with infect for each poison counter your opponents have

needs.what: a 1/1 green Phyrexian Insect creature token with infect (subtypes Phyrexian, Insect; keywords [infect])
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The token pool has insect_1_1_g (plain green Insect, no Phyrexian subtype, no infect) and phyrexian_mite_1_1_c_toxic, but no Phyrexian Insect with infect; create_token cannot add a subtype or keyword to an existing token id

needs.what: a value summing the poison counters across a player set, e.g. {"total_poison_of": "each_opponent"} = the total number of poison counters your opponents have
needs.why_existing_wont_do: max_poison_of returns only the most poison counters on one opponent, and sum takes a fixed list of value expressions rather than iterating a player set, so in multiplayer Commander the total across opponents cannot be said
